about: The source model of a GRIB edition 2 file (spec/zarrify/grib.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/grib.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the file, each message, its sections, the padding between messages and the fields play, each with the constraints the input must meet (spec/zarrify/grib.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/grib.md#8-grib-profile>). The parser checks them in this order. A field that the profile cannot present does not reject the input: it is recorded with its reason. Projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of a GRIB file, a store run's: the GRIB file is object 0, described in place, and an index beside it, when the run found one, is held. L is a message's length, n a section's.

<file>/messages/<i>.extent: (start, L): message i, i from 0, in the file's order

<file>/messages/<i>/sections/<j>.about: the message's j-th section after section 0, j from 0: sections 1 to 5 a value {length:>u4,number:u1,body:bytes[n - 5]}; section 6 a value {length:>u4,number:u1,indicator:u1} without a bitmap, else a struct of the value header and the data bitmap; section 7 data, form {geometry: {points, values}, codec: {packing, field}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}

<file>/gaps/<offset>.about: bytes between messages, or after the last, that are not a message

constraints.message: file too short for a GRIB message

given.whole: the file holds 16 bytes at it

constraints.message: the file ends inside the GRIB message at byte {at}
a GRIB edition {edition} message at byte {at}: only edition 2 is read
the GRIB message at byte {at} has the length {length}, past the {end}-byte file
the GRIB message at byte {at} does not end with 7777

given.offset: the section's offset in the message
given.room: the message's bytes from the section to section 8

constraints.message: the section {number} at byte {offset} of the GRIB message at byte {at} has the length {length}, past the message's end
the section {number} of the GRIB message at byte {at} has {length} octets, more than the profile reads

given.problem: what is wrong with its sections' order or contents, or absent

given.length: the bytes before the next message, or to the file's end
given.found: a message follows them, or the file ends within max_padding bytes

constraints.message: the bytes at byte {at} are not a GRIB message

given.reasons: the reasons the others are not, comma-separated

constraints.message: none of the {fields} GRIB fields can be presented: {reasons}
